findings.desc: CHK-007:edge:1 inject repro is mechanically unsound: the command uses `echo ... > file` (untracked) then runs verify-lattice-residue.mjs, but the gate enumerates files via `git ls-files` which only sees TRACKED files. An untracked inject will NOT appear in git ls-files output and therefore the gate would NOT fail. The note claims the gate exited 1 FAIL, but this cannot be reproduced by the documented command. CHK-004:adversarial:0 demonstrates the correct approach (git add before running the gate). The edge:1 evidence does not actually verify zero-tolerance detection of new untracked koala files.

CHK-001:adversarial:1 evidence command is pseudocode, not a real runnable command: `node -e '...HMAC sign(old koala-finding-integrity-v1) vs verify(new lattice-finding-integrity-v1); assert accepted===false'` contains a `...` ellipsis placeholder and is not executable as written. The note claims ASSERT-OK, but the command cannot produce that output. The underlying fact (different HMAC salts reject cross-salt verification) is sound, but the evidence is not backed by a concrete reproducible command. As a logic_test evidence entry, a minimal concrete Node.js assertion (e.g. using crypto.createHmac with the two different salts and asserting the digests differ) is required.
